name: Ola Electric Mobility Ltd
title: Ola Electric Mobility Ltd - 544225 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 margins rebounded to 38.5% gross on low volumes, but Q4 revenue was weak and recovery depends on unproven demand ramp, Gigafactory scale-up and capital raise at the cell subsidiary.

capex.peers_comment: Management said competitors will need to do more CapEx and new product rollouts; Ola's CapEx is behind it.
capex.quote: while other competitors will need to do more CapEx as well as new product rollouts, we have our capacity on both automotive and Gigafactory covered because all the CapEx is now behind us

triggers.label: Auto maintenance capex ~Rs 50 cr/yr
triggers.quote: in Auto, on an annual basis you should expect very incremental CapEx, maybe ₹50-odd crores that's about it.

triggers.label: Q1 FY27 orders 40-45k, revenue Rs 500-550 cr
triggers.quote: we expect 40,000 to 45,000 orders and consolidated revenue of 500 to 550 crores, nearly double of the Q4 level

triggers.label: Free inventory days 3-4 in May
triggers.quote: Our inventory, free inventory days is actually down to 3 -4 days and we have auto backlog now.

triggers.label: Gross margin 38.5% vs 13.7% a year ago
triggers.quote: consolidated gross margins reached 38.5%, up from 34.3% in Q3 and 13.7% in Q4

triggers.label: April registrations up 20% MoM
triggers.quote: April registrations were up 20% month-on-month, while the broader E two-wheeler industry declined by more than 22%.

guidance.quote: we expect 40,000 to 45,000 orders and consolidated revenue of 500 to 550 crores
consolidated revenue of 500 to 550 crores, nearly double of the Q4 level
We expect OpEx to move towards approximately 350 crores.
adjusted operating EBITDA breakeven is achievable at around 20,000 to 25,000 units per month
there will be about ₹300-₹500 crores of operating cashflow burn over the course of this year

guidance.value: 6 GWh installed; 2+ GWh output by September
guidance.quote: by end of next quarter, which is September, we expect our Gigafactory to be producing about 2+ GWh already

guidance.metric: Full vehicle portfolio on own cells
guidance.quote: we plan to transition the full vehicle portfolio to our own cells by September 2026

red_flags.label: Q4 revenue collapse; OpEx and deliveries sharply lower
red_flags.quote: Q4 revenues were low because deliveries were low.

red_flags.label: Cell business needs external capital; 20 GWh expansion unfunded
red_flags.quote: we are going to be expanding that 6 to 20 GWh by next year, but only by raising capital separately at the cell entity

red_flags.label: Revenue recognition change on extended warranty packages
red_flags.quote: this time with our auditors we decided that we will not recognize it upfront

red_flags.label: Product launch delays and Gigafactory commissioning slippage
red_flags.quote: It was supposed to be done a month back, but due to the Iran war, some containers got delayed.

evasions.topic: Registrations vs revenue gap in Q4
evasions.quote: Okay, Meet, I don't know what exactly you're referring to but
Amod, I can't share too much but we have a lot of interest from people on that front
